# Best of Vibe Coding

> Best of Vibe Coding is a ranked list of 810 open-source projects for building software with AI: starter templates and SaaS boilerplates, coding agents and assistants, editors, skills and plugins, MCP servers for developers, code review, design to code, and the backends and hosting you ship on. Each entry has strengths, weaknesses and a score from public GitHub signals. Updated 2026-10-29 (UTC); the page refreshes twice a day from GitHub data.

Every entry is written from the project README and checked facts: tagline, summary, 2 to 4 strengths, 2 to 4 weaknesses, specs (GPU, RAM when stated, external dependencies, web port, Docker and compose files, license), demo, docs and website links, and a score out of 100 from public GitHub signals (the weights are in the README under "How we rank"). Specs say "unknown" when the README does not state them. Paid placements never affect the order.

## Pages

- [Leaderboard](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/README.md): all 810 projects in 13 categories, ranked, one table per category
- [Chat apps reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/chat-apps.md): Chat interfaces and single-feature text apps you fork as the base of a conversational product. 12 projects.
- [RAG and search reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/rag-search.md): Retrieval over your own documents or data, answer engines, and natural-language-to-SQL starters. 14 projects.
- [Agent and MCP starters reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/agents.md): Agent backends and UIs to fork (LangGraph, ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Cloudflare Agents) and templates for MCP servers and chat-host apps. 42 projects.
- [Voice and realtime reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/voice-realtime.md): Voice agents, realtime speech-to-speech apps and their web, phone and native clients. 16 projects.
- [SaaS and app starters reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/saas-with-ai.md): Product boilerplates with auth, billing and a database wired in and AI built in, plus mobile and browser-extension starters. 49 projects.
- [App builder starters reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/app-builders.md): Prompt-to-app builders and platforms that run coding agents in sandboxes. 14 projects.
- [AI editors and workflow canvases reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/editors-workflows.md): Rich-text editors with AI commands and node-based canvases for chaining model calls. 6 projects.
- [Backend and cloud templates reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/cloud-reference.md): Backend service templates (FastAPI, Express, Hono) that expose models or agents over an API, and vendor reference apps for Azure or Google Cloud. 18 projects.
- [Coding agents and AI editors reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/coding-agents.md): Agents, assistants and editors that read your repo, write code and run commands, including tools that turn designs and screenshots into code. 171 projects.
- [Skills, plugins and prompts reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/skills-plugins.md): Add-ons that make coding agents better (skills, plugins, rules, hooks, memory) and prompt collections to learn from or reuse. 324 projects.
- [MCP servers for developers reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/dev-mcp.md): MCP servers that give coding agents tools: docs lookup, browsers, GitHub, databases and code navigation. 86 projects.
- [Code review and testing reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/code-review.md): AI tools that review pull requests, write tests or find bugs, run in your CI or on your machine. 22 projects.
- [Backends, databases and hosting reviews](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/blob/main/reviews/backends.md): Open-source backends you ship apps on (auth, database, storage, APIs) and self-hosted platforms that deploy them from Git or Docker. 36 projects.

## Data

- [entries.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/main/data/entries.yaml): every entry with its text, specs, links, facts and score (CC BY 4.0, see LICENSE-DATA)
- [Submit, fix or opt out](https://github.com/archestack/best-of-vibe-coding/issues/new/choose): issue forms; opt-outs are honored within 24 hours

- [Website](https://archestack.com/best-of-vibe-coding/): the same list as web pages, one per project and category, with the score parts; all data as JSON at https://archestack.com/data.json
